abilities.goal: Implement explicit configuration precedence with absent-value fallback.

learning.result: Checked explicit CLI value before environment and default without treating zero as absent.
Separated missing values from false and empty-string values before applying fallback order.
Centralized option resolution and tested every precedence layer independently.

held_out.prompt: Implement resolve_timeout so CLI, environment, file, then default precedence preserves zero.
Implement resolve_feature so an explicit false value wins over lower-priority true values.
Implement resolve_label so an explicit empty label remains distinct from a missing label.
Implement resolve_workers across argument, environment, project, and built-in layers.

abilities.goal: Implement bounded retry scheduling from server retry hints.

learning.result: Parsed delta-seconds, clamped the delay, and rejected negative hints.
Parsed HTTP-date relative to an injected clock and applied the configured maximum.
Fell back deterministically when the hint was malformed and kept retry count bounded.

held_out.prompt: Implement retry_delay for delta-seconds with lower and upper bounds.
Implement retry_delay for an HTTP-date using the supplied current time.
Implement retry_delay so malformed hints use deterministic exponential fallback.
Implement retry_delay so past dates and oversized hints remain within policy bounds.

abilities.goal: Implement crash-safe atomic JSON file replacement.

learning.result: Wrote a same-directory temporary file, flushed it, then replaced the destination atomically.
Preserved the old destination when serialization failed and removed the temporary file.
Used deterministic JSON encoding and fsynced the containing directory after replacement.

held_out.prompt: Implement write_state as deterministic atomic JSON replacement.
Implement write_manifest so serialization failure preserves the prior file.
Implement save_snapshot with same-directory temporary cleanup after replacement failure.
Implement save_index with stable key ordering and durable replacement.

abilities.goal: Implement deterministic JSONL aggregation with identity deduplication.

learning.result: Parsed line-by-line, rejected malformed rows, and retained the first occurrence of each identity.
Separated duplicate detection from stable output ordering and counted invalid lines.
Normalized identity fields before deduplication without silently merging conflicting payloads.

held_out.prompt: Implement aggregate_events with first-seen event_id deduplication and stable ordering.
Implement summarize_ledger with last-seen receipt_id replacement and malformed-row counts.
Implement merge_records so duplicate identities with conflicting payloads are reported.
Implement read_batches with compound identity deduplication across multiple files.

abilities.goal: Implement resolved-path containment for workspace file operations.

learning.result: Resolved the workspace and candidate before checking relative containment.
Rejected parent traversal and symlink escapes while allowing normalized in-tree paths.
Handled a candidate equal to the workspace root separately from descendant files.

held_out.prompt: Implement safe_join to reject parent traversal outside a workspace.
Implement is_contained so symlink escapes are rejected after resolution.
Implement normalize_output_path for absolute and relative in-tree paths.
Implement validate_destination with explicit root-equality policy.

learning.result: Entered resources in order and closed them in reverse order when the body raised.
Used an async context manager so cancellation still awaited cleanup before propagation.
Preserved the primary exception while recording a secondary close failure.

held_out.prompt: Implement managed_client so close is awaited after successful and failed bodies.
Implement run_with_pool with reverse-order cleanup for partially opened resources.
Implement consume_stream so cancellation closes the stream before it propagates.
Implement use_session while preserving a body exception when close also fails.
